components.name: prefix
components.description: The token endpoint reference says the client secret begins with cnvca; no separator, alphabet or length is stated.

claims.statement: The Canva REST API authentication guide lists generating and saving a client secret as a prerequisite, and the token endpoint documents a client_secret parameter that begins with cnvca.

sources.supports: Before authenticating to the REST APIs, you must first create and configure your app in the Developer Portal, including: ... Generating and saving a client secret
client_secret string Optional Your app's client secret, for authenticating the request. Begins with cnvca .

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Whether the prefix is stable across app generations, and the length, alphabet and any checksum of the remainder, are not stated by the pages read. The client secret is carried either in an HTTP Basic Authorization header (Base64 of client id and client secret joined by a colon, as the authentication guide states) or as a client_secret form body parameter; the carrier encodings are not researched here. The candidate is not researched beyond existence and a documented prefix. On 2026-10-04 no Canva rule was found in the Gitleaks, TruffleHog, Nosey Parker, detect-secrets or secrets-patterns-db rule sets (the TruffleHog and secrets-patterns-db gocanvas entries concern a different product), so no tool-corroborated claim about length or alphabet is possible; GitHub's supported secret scanning patterns page lists Canva secret types without stating a format.
